sn9.3:1.1: Kassapagotta appears also in [an3.91](), where he initially resents the training before repenting.
sn9.3:1.2: _Cheta_ (variants _ceṭa_, _ceta_) is unsatisfactory. Commentary explains as “deer hunter”, apparently from the root _chid_ (“cut, destroy”; cf. Sanskrit _chettṛ_). A “nimrod” is both a “hunter” and an “idiot”.
